hotel.name: The St. Regis Macao, Cotai Central

verified_facts.text: The hotel's address is The Londoner Macao, Estrada do Istmo, Cotai, Macau.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Londoner Macao, Estrada do Istmo s/n, Cotai, Macau, China

verified_facts.text: The hotel is on the Cotai Strip, in a center for entertainment and shopping with more than 850 luxury stores.
verified_facts.excerpt: is a center for entertainment and shopping that boasts more than 850 luxury stores and an array of dining options

verified_facts.text: Macau International Airport is about 3 kilometers from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: The closest airport near The St. Regis Macao is Macau International Airport (MFM). MFM is located approximately 3.0 KM from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not have an airport shuttle to Macau International Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, The St. Regis Macao does not have an airport shuttle to Macau International Airport.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's design combines classic motifs with local Macanese inspiration.
verified_facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Macao is an impeccable union of classic motifs and local Macanese inspiration.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites are fitted with traditional Chinese elements and have marble bathrooms with bath products from SACHAJUAN, Sodashi and REN.
verified_facts.excerpt: luxury hotel rooms or suites fitted with traditional Chinese elements, each boasting dramatic views and marble bathrooms with a bespoke amenity collection featuring best-in-class product lines from SACHAJUAN, Sodashi and REN skincare

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Butler service is available to all hotel guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: The St. Regis signature Butler service is available to all hotel guests

verified_facts.text: Marble bathrooms have a double-basin vanity, a separate shower and soaking bathtub, and a mirror-embedded LCD television.
verified_facts.excerpt: The marble bathroom invites indulgence with a double-basin vanity, separate shower and soaking bathtub, as well as a mirror-embedded LCD television.

verified_facts.text: Rooms offer The St. Regis bed and pillow menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: The St. Regis bed and pillow menu ensure exceptional comfort and a restful night's sleep.

verified_facts.text: The Manor, the hotel's signature restaurant, serves Mediterranean dining with artisanal seafood and crafted cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Manor elevates Mediterranean dining with artisanal seafood and crafted cocktails, blending tradition with modern flair.

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Bar's setting is inspired by the House of Astor and it serves artisan cocktails and chef-crafted menus.
verified_facts.excerpt: offering artisan cocktails and chef-crafted menus in a contemporary setting inspired by the House of Astor

verified_facts.text: The hotel's signature cocktail, Maria do Leste, is its interpretation of the Bloody Mary, inspired by the voyages of Portuguese sailors.
verified_facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Macao Signature Cocktail, Maria do Leste, takes inspiration from the worldly voyages of the Portuguese sailors whose exploration established Macau as an important trading port.

verified_facts.text: The Pavilion offers casual alfresco dining with family-friendly fare beside the outdoor pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ideal for casual alfresco dining on the Cotai Strip in Macau, The Pavilion offers refreshing beverages and family-friendly fare beside the outdoor pool.

verified_facts.text: The outdoor pool is on the eighth floor, with an all-day menu and full beverage service.
verified_facts.excerpt: features an outdoor pool on the eighth floor with an all-day menu and full beverage service

verified_facts.text: The pool area has two whirlpools.
verified_facts.excerpt: Two spacious whirlpools add to the ambience of this tranquil haven.

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Athletic Club is on the eighth floor with floor-to-ceiling views of the Cotai Strip.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the eighth floor, it boasts floor-to-ceiling views of the inspiring Cotai Strip.

verified_facts.text: The concierge team can arrange excursions and coordinate reservations for ferry cruises and helicopter tours.
verified_facts.excerpt: our Concierge team is available to coordinate reservations for ferry cruises and helicopter tours

verified_facts.text: Guests can join a mixologist at The St. Regis Bar to mix their own Bloody Mary cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: join our mixologist and mix your own Bloody Mary cocktails

verified_facts.text: In a small-group cooking class, the hotel's chefs teach guests to make two signature dishes from The Manor.
verified_facts.excerpt: our expert chefs will guide and teach you in a small group the fundamentals of crafting two signature dishes from The Manor

verified_facts.text: A candy workshop features Yau Kei's Dragon's Beard Candy, demonstrated by second-generation master Kenny Yuen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join us as Kenny Yuen, the second-generation master, demonstrates this intangible Cultural Heritage, allowing you to explore exquisite pulled sugar creations at the House of Astor.

verified_facts.text: The Astor Ballroom is a pillarless venue for up to 450 wedding guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Astor Ballroom offers timeless elegance and an expansive, pillarless venue catering for up to 450 wedding guests.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a Forbes Travel Guide 2026 Five-Star Hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Forbes Travel Guide 2026 – Five-Star Hotel

verified_facts.text: Children 1.4 meters tall and under must wear arm bands or life vests in the pools, which the hotel provides free of charge.
verified_facts.excerpt: All children 1.4 meters in height and under are required to wear inflatable arm bands or life vests when using hotel swimming facilities. Both are provided on a complimentary basis by the hotel.

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at The St. Regis Macao.

verified_facts.text: Hong Kong International Airport is 60 kilometers from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Hong Kong International Airport

verified_facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler lists the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards 2023, 2025 and 2026.
verified_facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2023, 2025, 2026
